title: Reuse shared trees and blobs when auditing ordinary task-sync publication history
outcome: An initial push can audit previously unpublished data history within the request budget by reusing unchanged directory and blob validation across distinct Git trees.
acceptance: A behavioral fixture with many commits sharing task and memory blobs proves the audit still refuses restricted content in any outgoing tree, including when the destination ref is absent.
Git object and decode work scales with distinct changed inputs. Preserve exact remote-basis binding and the fail-closed request deadline.
